_howto: Owner-editable announcement feed. The app fetches this fresh on every cold start (web + native) — edit, commit, push; NO Play rollout needed. Each message shows once per device (tracked by id). Fields: id (required, unique, never reuse), enabled (set true to go live), title, body (array of plain-text paragraphs — HTML is NOT rendered), cta_label + cta_url (optional button, https only), platforms (optional: ["android"], ["web"] or both), minVersion/maxVersion (optional APP_VERSION range, e.g. only nudge old builds), starts/ends (optional ISO dates for a time window).

messages.title: Sample announcement
body: This is a sample message — flip "enabled" to true and push to show it to everyone.
